acceptance_criteria: corrupted, incomplete, stale, cross-scope, and unauthorized-region recovery attempts fail closed
restore replays are idempotent and reconcile manifests, database references, object hashes, audit chronology, and queues before writes reopen
legal holds block purge and backup expiry
deletion graphs retain impact, approvals, cross-store propagation, exceptions, and cryptographic-erasure evidence
ordinary restore cannot resurrect data after completed deletion
tenant offboarding produces verified open exports plus retention and deletion reports
fixity, format migration, offline viewing, succession, shutdown, and portability controls retain originals and open formats
v1.0 migration is additive, provenance-based, conservative, rollback-backed, and signed
synthetic game days retain measured RPO/RTO and a verified portability export without claiming cloud or production certification
complete exact-commit acceptance and both dedicated package verifiers return zero findings
dependency_rationale: Progress 09 closed OPS-003 and True North authorized only OPS-004 as its bounded successor.
external_gaps: Database PITR and object-version recovery require credentialed managed database and object-store execution.
Multi-region service-loss and cross-region recovery require executed cloud evidence and residency review.
Physical edge recovery, key-custodian ceremonies, and external witnessing remain unexecuted.
Production RPO/RTO certification, customer data recovery, and legal/evidentiary review remain external.

included_requirements.requirement: Each component shall declare blast radius, retry safety, recovery point, recovery time, and degraded behavior.
Worker resource exhaustion shall terminate the job without terminating shared control-plane services.
Object-store write success shall be followed by hash verification before database publication.
Index outage shall fall back to bounded metadata navigation rather than returning unauthorized or stale results.
Provider-region failure shall not trigger unapproved cross-region data movement.
Every stored asset and record shall have retention class, policy source, hold status, and deletion eligibility.
A deletion request shall produce impact analysis, authorization, execution plan, completion evidence, and unresolved exceptions.
Consent revocation shall stop future processing immediately and trigger policy-defined handling of prior derivatives.
Backups shall expire deleted data within a documented bounded period while preventing ordinary restoration from resurrecting access.
Tenant offboarding shall provide a verified export and deletion/retention report.
Deletion shall propagate to derived search/vector indexes and cached viewer assets.
An import shall report accepted, transformed, skipped, duplicate, conflicting, unsupported, and quarantined items.
An export shall include source commit, query/scope, permissions/consent decision, redactions, transformations, output hashes, and limitations.
Full-project export shall include originals when authorized, canonical manifests, scene graph, history, evidence, open-format geometry/media, and checksums.
The system shall support dry-run migration and deterministic re-execution.
Password-protected or encrypted input shall never be weakened or logged without explicit authorized handling.
Portability verification shall run on a clean offline viewer/reference importer.
Hybrid export shall preserve role, authority, transform, derivation, use suitability, limitations, support maps, and policy labels.
External/manual provider export shall be minimized, purpose-limited, hashed, expiring, and receipted.
Import shall quarantine unknown providers, roles, extensions, transforms, and authority claims.
Full-project export shall include visual, metric, interaction, design, evidence, and non-splat fallback assets when authorized.
Format conversion shall retain irreversible-loss declarations and source relationships.
A clean reference importer shall reconstruct the hybrid layer registry without vendor-specific private knowledge.
Preservation packages shall include originals, technical metadata, rights/consent, transcripts, memory graph, scene/evidence manifests, open spatial assets, checksums, and human-readable guides.
The system shall perform scheduled fixity checks and repair from independent replicas when authorized.
Format migration shall preserve originals and create documented derivatives with validation.
At least one edition shall be viewable without a proprietary cloud API.
Succession plans shall define administrators, recovery methods, keys, billing/retention choices, and prohibited uses.
Service shutdown planning shall include bulk export, key handoff or cryptographic deletion, and clear family notice.
Recovery objectives shall be declared by data/service class and deployment profile.
Database backups shall support point-in-time recovery and periodic isolated restore tests.
Object storage shall use versioning/immutability or equivalent protections against accidental/malicious deletion.
Key recovery shall be tested without exposing root keys to ordinary operators.
A restore shall reconcile manifests/hashes, database references, object assets, audit chronology, and queued jobs before reopening writes.
Disaster tests shall include a complete tenant/project portability export when service recovery is not practical.
Migration shall preserve every canonical v1.0 source asset and shall create additive v1.1 records rather than rewriting geometry bytes in place.
Role and authority assignment shall be based on provenance and verification evidence, never file extension or visual appearance.
Ambiguous assets, frames, anchors, or measurements shall be quarantined or conservatively classified and shall not receive privileged intended uses.
Existing permissions, classification, consent, retention, legal hold, and deletion dependencies shall remain equivalent or more restrictive after migration.
Legacy proxy-like or visual measurements shall remain approximate unless eligible metric/field evidence supports a higher status.
Entity identity and source evidence shall survive migration independently of mesh primitive IDs and renderer objects.
Rollback shall be demonstrated from a restorable v1.0 backup without loss or mutation of original assets.
Compatibility APIs shall translate read behavior conservatively and shall prevent v1.0 clients from bypassing v1.1 authority or publication rules.
Down-level exports shall report omitted or degraded v1.1 content and shall not relabel proxy/design/generated assets as metric or observed.
Migration shall produce a signed report of asset mappings, quarantines, unresolved anchors, policy diffs, validation results, and rollback evidence.

scope_statement: Progress 10 is limited to OPS-004 backup, restore, disaster recovery, retention, deletion, portability contingency, preservation, and conservative v1.0 migration safeguards. QA-002, pilots, Progress 11, production credentials, production traffic, and production promotion remain unauthorized.
